name: Upper Dolpo Trek
sub_region: Dolpa District, Karnali Province; Shey-Phoksundo National Park

difficulty.notes: Remote camping trek with multiple passes above 5,000 m (Kang La 5,360 m, Saldang La / Sela La approx. 5,100 m, Jeng La approx. 5,090-5,120 m) and several consecutive nights above 3,500-4,000 m; few facilities, rough trails, flight-dependent access.

duration_days.basis: Full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu (21 trekking days Juphal-Juphal plus Kathmandu-Nepalgunj-Juphal flights)
duration_days.notes: Common variants: 20-21 trek days Juphal-Juphal loop via Shey Gompa, Saldang and Dho Tarap; 24-day versions add Yangze Gompa; Upper Dolpo to Jomsom (Mustang) traverse variants run longer. Add 1-2 spare days for weather-dependent Nepalgunj-Juphal flights.

itinerary.notes: Lowland gateway town for western Nepal flights.
Early-morning flight; frequent weather cancellations. Juphal airstrip approx. 2,475 m.
Enter Shey-Phoksundo National Park; Suli Gad gorge.
Views of Phoksundo waterfall and first views of Phoksundo Lake.

itinerary.route: Rest and acclimatization at Ringmo / Phoksundo Lake
itinerary.notes: Visit Tshowa Bon monastery and lakeshore.

itinerary.route: Ringmo - along Phoksundo Lake west shore - Phoksundo Khola
Phoksundo Khola - Phoksundo Bhanjyang (Kang La base)
itinerary.notes: Large sleeping-altitude gain; some operators camp higher (approx. 4,600-4,700 m).

itinerary.route: Cross Kang La (5,360 m) - Shey Gompa
itinerary.notes: Shey Gompa altitude is given variously as 4,340-4,500 m (UNVERIFIED exact figure).

itinerary.route: Rest day at Shey Gompa; Crystal Mountain area
Shey Gompa - Saldang La / Sela La (approx. 5,100 m) - Namgung (Namduna)
itinerary.notes: Pass name and height vary by source (Sela La 5,110 m; Saldang La approx. 5,100 m). Namgung red monastery.
One of the largest villages in Upper Dolpo; altitude given 3,620-3,900 m by different sources.
Keep 1-2 contingency days for flight delays.

best_seasons.notes: NTB lists Mar-May and Sep-Oct as best season for Shey-Phoksundo NP. Upper Dolpo lies in the Dhaulagiri rain shadow, so many operators also run it in the monsoon months, but Nepalgunj-Juphal flights are frequently disrupted then (UNVERIFIED as a recommendation; operator claim). High passes are snowbound in winter.

permits.name: Upper Dolpo (Upper Dolpa) Restricted Area Permit
permits.fee: USD 500 per person for the first 10 days, then USD 50 per person per day
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Dolpo Buddha RM wards 4-6, Shey Phoksundo RM wards 1-7, Charka Tangsong RM wards 1-6
permits.valid_from: Department of Immigration schedule (unchanged as of late 2025; TAAN requested a per-day structure)

permits.name: Lower Dolpo Restricted Area Permit (route passes Lower Dolpa wards, e.g. Dunai/Thulibheri and Shey Phoksundo RM wards 8-9)
permits.fee: USD 20 per person per week, USD 5 per person per week beyond 1 week

permits.name: Shey-Phoksundo National Park entry
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Upper Dolpo is on the NTB guide-and-TIMS route list

guide_requirements: Restricted area: permit only through a government-registered trekking agency with a licensed trekking guide. Since 22 March 2026 the Department of Immigration issues restricted-area permits to solo trekkers too (previously minimum 2), with max 7 trekkers per guide and the agency responsible for rescue. Upper Dolpo is also on the NTB list of routes requiring a licensed guide and agency TIMS card.

flights: Nepalgunj - Juphal (approx. 35 min; weather-sensitive, early morning)
drives: Seasonal road access to Dunai via Surkhet and Jajarkot (part of the year only)
logistics.notes: Fully supported camping trek above Ringmo; very limited lodges. Carry contingency days for Juphal flights.

highlights: Crossing Kang La (5,360 m) into Upper Dolpo
Shey Gompa (Crystal Monastery) and Crystal Mountain
Saldang, Namgung and Dho Tarap villages with Tibetan Buddhist and Bon culture
Shey-Phoksundo National Park wildlife (blue sheep; snow leopard habitat)
risks: High-altitude passes above 5,000 m and long stretches above 4,000 m (AMS risk)
Remote location; evacuation depends on helicopter and weather
Snow on passes outside main season

acclimatization.notes: Kang La approach involves large sleeping-altitude gains; some operators add an extra camp below the pass.

unverified: Upper Dolpo RAP fee: Department of Immigration and NTB French page list USD 500 for 10 days + USD 50/day; TAAN (Nov 2025) confirms it was not changed; but the NTB English page currently lists USD 50 per person per day (same as new Upper Mustang rate). Confirm with DoI before quoting.
Shey Gompa altitude varies 4,340-4,500 m between sources.
Saldang La / Sela La height approx. 5,100 m and Jeng La 5,090-5,120 m vary by source.
Suitability of the monsoon months (Jun-Aug) is an operator claim, not an official season.
